title: PA
description:
Interim PAShrewsbury
Your new company

Hays are proud to be supporting a respected public sector organisation in Shrewsbury with the recruitment of an PA on an interim basis. This is an exciting opportunity to join a busy Corporate Services team, providing high-level administrative and executive support to senior leaders whilst playing a key role in supporting governance, committee administration and organisational events.

Your new role

As PA, you will provide comprehensive administrative and secretarial support to senior management, including diary management, meeting coordination, minute-taking and the preparation of reports and correspondence. You will support a range of committees and governance meetings, ensuring agendas, papers and actions are produced and managed accurately and within legislative requirements.

The role will involve maintaining confidential records, coordinating events, supporting disciplinary and grievance administration, handling incoming communications and assisting with the organisation of travel, accommodation and corporate meetings. You'll be a key point of contact for internal stakeholders and external partners, ensuring a professional and efficient service is delivered at all times.

What you'll need to succeed

To be successful in this role, you will have previous experience in an administrative, executive support or secretarial position, ideally gained within a complex environment. You will be highly organised, capable of managing multiple priorities and confident in working with senior stakeholders.
You will also possess:
- Strong diary management and meeting coordination experience
- Excellent minute-taking and administrative skills
- Outstanding written and verbal communication skills
- The ability to handle confidential information with discretion
- Strong Microsoft Office skills
- A proactive and professional approach with excellent attention to detail

What you'll get in return
- Interim role for 3 months
- Full-time, 37 hours per week
- Based in Shrewsbury
- Varied and rewarding role supporting senior leadership
- Opportunity to work within a well-established public sector organisation
- Excellent professional development opportunities

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant

Cosgrove & Cosgrove Ltd Telford, Shropshire

£28,000-£30,000 per annum depending on experience Full-time Permanent Office-based

Cosgrove & Cosgrove is looking for an experienced Accounts Assistant to join our small finance team in Telford, supporting the day-to-day accounts across multiple businesses.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys keeping accurate records, resolving queries and taking ownership of their work. You should be confident completing bank reconciliations independently and managing a varied workload without constant supervision.

What you'll be doing
- Completing bank reconciliations independently across multiple accounts and investigating discrepancies.
- Maintaining purchase and sales ledgers, processing supplier invoices, and raising and processing sales invoices.
- Processing expenses and credit card transactions, matching receipts and following up missing information.
- Using Dext to support invoice and receipt processing.
- Carrying out bookkeeping and data entry, keeping QuickBooks Online records accurate and up to date.
- Preparing and posting journals, including payroll journals, and collating payroll information.
- Liaising with colleagues and suppliers to resolve queries.
- Supporting month-end tasks and the wider finance team.

What we're looking for
- At least two years' practical UK accounts or bookkeeping experience.
- The ability to complete bank reconciliations independently.
- Practical experience of purchase and sales ledgers, supplier invoices and expenses.
- Good Excel skills and practical experience using QuickBooks Online. Both are essential.
- Strong attention to detail, good organisation and the ability to prioritise your workload.
- A reliable commute to our Telford office for this fully office-based role.

Experience using Dext would be an advantage. An AAT qualification or progress towards one would be useful, but is not essential; practical experience and the ability to do the work are what matter.

How to apply

Please submit your CV and include a short covering note answering the following:
- How many years of practical UK accounts or bookkeeping experience do you have?
- How many years have you used QuickBooks Online, and have you used Dext?
- What experience do you have of preparing payroll information and posting payroll journals?
- How would you describe your Excel level? Please give examples of the functions or tasks you use regularly.
- What are you looking for in your next role and why are you leaving your current position? If you are not currently employed, please tell us what you are looking for next.
- What is your notice period or earliest available start date?

description:
Role Details

Role: Property Manager

Role Overview

Durrant Talent Solutions is proud to be partnering with a leading national residential managing agent in the search for a Property Manager to join their Shrewsbury team.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Property Manager to take ownership of a residential portfolio, delivering exceptional property management services while building strong relationships with leaseholders, residents, clients and contractors.

The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring developments are managed to the highest professional standards, maintaining compliance, overseeing maintenance and service delivery, and providing an outstanding customer experience across their portfolio.

Role Responsibilities

- Build and maintain strong relationships with leaseholders, Resident Management Companies (RMCs), Right to Manage Companies (RTMs) and freeholder clients.
- Prepare and manage annual service charge budgets in conjunction with internal teams.
- Monitor expenditure and ensure developments are managed within approved budgets.
- Arrange, attend and chair site inspections and client meetings as required.
- Instruct, monitor and review contractors to ensure works are completed to the required standard.
- Oversee planned and reactive maintenance across the portfolio.

- Work closely with internal departments including finance, compliance and customer services.
- Respond promptly and professionally to customer enquiries and resolve issues effectively.
- Ensure accurate property records are maintained and all administration is completed within agreed timescales.

Essential Experience

The successful candidate will have:
- Previous experience managing a residential block management portfolio.
- A good understanding of residential leasehold legislation and property management best practice.
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage a varied workload.
- A proactive and customer-focused approach.
- The ability to prioritise tasks and work independently.
- Competent IT skills, including Microsoft Office.
- A full UK driving licence (where required).

Desirable Experience
- TPI qualified or working towards level 3
- Experience using property management software such as Qube, TRAMPS, Propman or similar.

title: Payroll Assistant
description:
Role: Payroll Assistant

Location: West Midlands - Hybrid (1 day a week)

Duration: 3 Months

Hourly rate: up to £17.24 + Holiday per hour

Full Time: 36 hours per week

Sellick Partnership are currently recruiting for a Payroll Assistant to join our reputable public sector organisation based in West Midlands. This is a contract for 3 months, with a possibility to be extended, and is offered on a hybrid basis with a minimum of 1 day a week in the office.

The duties of the Payroll Assistant will include:
- Processing weekly and monthly payroll information
- Inputting employee data, including starters, leavers and contract changes
- Recording overtime, bonuses, commission payments and deductions
- Calculating statutory payments such as sick pay, maternity pay and paternity pay
- Checking timesheets and attendance records for accuracy
- Maintaining employee payroll records and personnel files
- Processing pension contributions and benefit deductions
- Responding to employee payroll queries and resolving discrepancies
- Producing payroll reports for management and finance teams
- Ensuring compliance with payroll legislation and company policies
- Submitting payroll data to HMRC and other relevant bodies
- Reconciling payroll reports and identifying any errors before payment runs
- Assisting with year-end payroll activities, including P60s and P11 Ds where required

The Payroll Assistant ideally should:
- Have a minimum of 2 years payroll experience
- Be educated to GCSE mathematics or equivalent
- Have experience in a similar level
- Have knowledge and understanding of current payroll legislation
- Have knowledge of statutory legislation including taxation, NI, SSP, SMP, SPP and P45s and P46s

The Payroll Assistant will need to have excellent communication skills and effectively be able to communicate to stakeholders of all levels. Furthermore, the ideal candidate will have an impeccable eye for detail and accuracy to ensure all workload is carried out effectively and efficiently. They will also need to able to prioritise their workload and be efficient and effective to meet unpredictable deadlines and deal with conflicting demands, whilst working in a high-pressured environment.

If you believe that you are well-suited to this excellent opportunity of Payroll Assistant, please apply directly or contact Charlotte Broomfield at Sellick Partnership for more information. The closing date for CVs is Tuesday 23th October due to the urgent requirement of this role. The closing date may be bought forward should suitable applicants apply.

Sellick Partnership is proud to be an inclusive and accessible recruitment business and we support applications from candidates of all backgrounds and circumstances. Please note, our advertisements use years' experience, hourly rates, and salary levels purely as a guide and we assess applications based on the experience and skills evidenced on the CV. For information on how your personal details may be used by Sellick Partnership, please review our data processing notice on our website.

title: Administrator - Data Entry Project
salary_text: £12.71 - £13 per hour (Immediate start and great training)
description:
Are you available to start a temporary data entry project ASAP?

We're looking for someone to support a busy data cleansing and administration project for a business based in Telford, specifically within the TF1 area, as they prepare for the implementation of a brand-new HR system in February.

There is a huge volume of employee data and physical documentation that needs to be reviewed, cleansed, updated and organised ahead of the changeover. You'll be supporting the team with a variety of data entry and general administration tasks, including scanning documents, logging information, organising paperwork, securely destroying documents where required and updating employee records.

This would be a fantastic opportunity for a graduate or school leaver looking to gain some valuable office administration experience, or someone who enjoys organised, process-driven work and is happy getting stuck into a busy data entry project.

The role is on a temporary basis, paying 13.00 per hour + holiday accrual, with weekly pay. The position will start ASAP and is expected to be ongoing, with the potential for around five months of work and possibly the opportunity to support the business further during the transition to its new HR system.

The hours are Monday to Friday, 8:30am-5:00pm, with a one-hour lunch break. Due to the nature of the project and the volume of physical paperwork involved, this will be a fully office-based position in Telford.

Please note that due to the type of project this is, the successful candidate will be required to sign an NDA before commencing any work.

What does the day-to-day look like?

This is a very admin-heavy, data entry-focused project, supporting the business in getting its employee records and documentation ready for a major HR system change.

You'll be scanning and logging documents, organising physical records, updating employee information, cleansing existing data and ensuring everything is accurate, up to date and ready for the transition. You'll need to be comfortable carrying out repetitive tasks and working through a high volume of information, with accuracy and attention to detail being key.

What do we need from you?
- Good attention to detail and the ability to work accurately with data and documentation.
- Basic computer skills and a willingness to learn new systems and processes.
- A proactive attitude and the ability to get stuck into a busy, hands-on administration project.
- Someone who is comfortable with repetitive data entry and document management tasks.
- The ability to start ASAP and commit to an ongoing temporary assignment.
- The ability to commute easily to the Telford TF1 area, as the role is fully office-based.

Previous office administration experience would be beneficial, but it's certainly not essential. We'd be very happy to hear from graduates, school leavers or anyone looking to gain valuable experience in an office environment.

What next?

If you're available to start ASAP and think this could be a good fit, apply for the role or get in touch with Bobby to find out more. We're keen to speak with candidates as soon as possible, with a view to getting someone started ASAP.

title: Technical Records Administrator - MFTS
company: Red Sky Personnel Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Technical Records Administrator MFTS

Location: Shawbury

About the Opportunity

We are recruiting on behalf of our client, a leading organisation within the helicopter and aviation industry, for a Technical Records Administrator to join their team based at Oxford Airport.

This is an excellent opportunity for a detail-oriented and organised individual to join a specialist aviation environment, supporting the management, review and maintenance of essential technical records.

The successful candidate will play an important role in ensuring technical documentation is accurate, up to date and compliant with relevant company procedures and aviation regulations. You will work closely with the Technical Records Supervisor and wider engineering and continuing airworthiness teams, helping maintain accurate records that support aircraft safety and airworthiness.

We are looking for someone methodical, proactive and confident working with digital systems, who can manage competing priorities and deliver work to agreed deadlines.

The Role

As a Technical Records Administrator, you will be responsible for the day-to-day review, processing and administration of aircraft maintenance records, ensuring that all relevant information is accurately recorded within the company's record management system.

You will support the wider technical and airworthiness teams by maintaining documentation, updating aircraft and component logbooks, preparing records for audits and ensuring records are properly archived.

Key Responsibilities
- Review and process technical records, ensuring accuracy and compliance with company procedures and applicable aviation regulations.
- Update the record management system with regulatory, optional and non-routine maintenance task completion details.
- Maintain and update aircraft and component logbooks.
- Copy, organise and archive aircraft maintenance records in accordance with established procedures.
- Return component log cards to the relevant materials management team for core returns.
- Assist with the preparation of technical documentation for regulatory audits.
- Generate monthly flying-hour reports and maintain accurate supporting records.
- Identify discrepancies, missing information or potential compliance issues and take appropriate action.
- Provide administrative and technical records support across the wider continuing airworthiness management team.
- Work closely with colleagues and management to ensure records are maintained accurately and within agreed timescales.
- Undertake additional duties as required by the department's management team.

Essential Skills and Experience

The successful candidate will demonstrate:
- A methodical approach to work and excellent attention to detail.
- The ability to work independently, use initiative and contribute effectively as part of a team.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to prioritise tasks against deadlines.
- A proactive approach to identifying errors, discrepancies and potential issues before they affect operations.
- Good computer literacy, including confidence using Google Docs and digital record management systems.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- The ability to communicate professionally with colleagues and stakeholders at different levels.
- A reliable, flexible and professional approach to work.

Desirable Skills and Experience

The following would be advantageous:
- Previous experience in an aviation, engineering or technical records environment.
- Knowledge of Continuing Airworthiness Management Organisation (CAMO) procedures.
- Familiarity with UK Civil Aviation Authority regulations, particularly Part-CAMO and Part-145.
- Experience using aviation maintenance or continuing airworthiness management software.
- Knowledge of aircraft maintenance documentation, component records and technical logbooks.
- An understanding of aviation human factors and airworthiness compliance.

Qualifications

Essential:
- A minimum of five GCSEs at Grade C or above, or equivalent recognised qualifications such as NVQs or BTECs.

Desirable:
- An aviation-related degree or equivalent qualification.
- Recognised Part-CAMO or Part-145 training.
- Aviation human factors training.

Additional Requirements

description:
We are recruiting on behalf of a dynamic and growing organisation based in Shropshire that is looking for an experienced and highly organised Project Coordinator to join their team. This is a fantastic opportunity to step into a pivotal role within a business that is genuinely ambitious, fast-moving, and invested in the people who help drive it forward.

Working in a hybrid capacity, you will have the flexibility to split your time between the London office and home, while playing a central role in the coordination and delivery of key projects across the business. If you are someone who thrives on keeping multiple workstreams on track, communicating clearly with stakeholders, and making sure things get done to the highest standard, this role is for you.

What You Will Be Doing
- Leading the day-to-day coordination of projects from initiation through to successful delivery
- Managing project timelines, milestones, and deliverables, ensuring deadlines are consistently met
- Facilitating project meetings, capturing actions, and holding teams accountable for progress
- Maintaining comprehensive project documentation, risk registers, and status reports

- Exceptional organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities across multiple projects
- Confident communicator - able to engage effectively with stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership
- Proficient in project management tools such as Jira, Asana, MS Project, or equivalent
- A proactive, solutions-focused mindset with excellent attention to detail
- Comfortable working independently in a hybrid environment
- A relevant project management qualification (e.g. PRINCE2, APM, PMP) is desirable but not essential

What Is On Offer
- Hybrid working - a flexible split between the London office and home
- 28 days annual leave plus bank holidays
- A high-profile role with genuine influence over project outcomes and business direction
- Fantastic opportunities to grow within the organisation, with clear pathways for career progression

title: Receptionist
description: We are looking for an enthusiastic, friendly and professional person to join our reception team! Marysville Medical Practice has a population list size of 6500, and is based in the Belle Vue area of Shrewsbury, in a modern, spacious building. Receptionists play a vital role in general practice; they are the first line of contact for all patients and members of the public visiting and telephoning the practice so first impressions are very important. You would be joining our supportive and friendly practice, providing a high standard of care to our patient population. Although experience of primary care is beneficial we are also interested in those with transferable skills. Good communication skills and a friendly but professional "can do" attitude is essential. We would be flexible for the right candidate but are looking for someone to join us on a full time basis, permanent contract. For more details and an informal discussion please contact Izzy.Culliss@nhs.net Reception Duties: Ensure efficiency of the EMIS computerized appointment system and monitor the flow of patients into consulting rooms. Ensure that patients without appointments but who need to see a doctor urgently are seen in a logical and non-disruptive manner. Respond to all requests for assistance and information from patients and other visitors Ensure all requests for prescriptions are actioned as per practice policy Ensure that all shared areas of the building are kept neat and tidy Management of EMIS Appointment Systems: Book appointments ensuring sufficient information is recorded to retrieve medical records Management of Medical Records: Retrieve and file records Ensure correspondence e.g. Reports, hospital letters, results are properly scanned and then filed accurately and in the correct order Operation of Telephone System: Receive calls, make calls, divert calls and take accurate messages as required. PURPOSE OF POST: To provide a point of contact for patients and act as a focal point of communication between patients, doctors, the Primary Health Care Team and the administration staff. Responsible To: Practice Manager Major Duties and Responsibilities of the Post Reception Duties Management of EMIS Appointment Systems Management of Medical Records Operation of Telephone System Start and End of Day Procedures Specialist tasks once proficient at the basic level e.g. 1) Preparation of specialist reports including tracking payment and dispatch or reports by Recorded delivery 2) Implementing the Childhood Immunisation recall system. 3) Receiving and dispatching medical records as patients join, leave or die, this includes use of the GP2GP electronic system 4) Carrying out medical audit under GPs direction 5) Assembling and dispatching FP10s and associated Annexes to the Prescriptions Pricing Authority. 7) Recall of patients in chronic Disease management 8) Recording of cytology results and administrative duties within this area 9) Co-ordination of vasectomy clinics and all administrative duties associated with this Any other delegated duties considered appropriate to the post Special Requirements of the Post: An understanding, acceptance and adherence to the need for strict confidentiality as failure to do so will result in dismissal An ability to use own judgment, resourcefulness, common sense to respond to patients non clinical inquiries and requests Excellent communication skills Accuracy in transcribing information Ability to work without supervision and determine own workload priorities Keyboard skills and computer literacy skills desirable Ability to work well within a team and under pressure Ability to be flexible within the working week if needed, and to be prepared to work some early mornings/evenings and weekends as and when required
